keyPoints.en: Simple interest: I = Prt (t in years).
keyPoints.bm: Faedah mudah: I = Prt (t dalam tahun).

keyPoints.en: Compound interest: MV = P(1 + r/n)ⁿᵗ; n = number of times compounded per year.
keyPoints.bm: Faedah kompaun: MV = P(1 + r/n)ⁿᵗ; n = bilangan kali dikompaun setahun.

keyPoints.en: ROI = total return ÷ initial investment × 100% (returns include dividends, rent and capital gain).
keyPoints.bm: ROI = jumlah pulangan ÷ pelaburan awal × 100% (pulangan termasuk dividen, sewa dan keuntungan modal).

keyPoints.en: Compare investments by return, risk and liquidity; spreading money across several reduces risk.
keyPoints.bm: Bandingkan pelaburan mengikut pulangan, risiko dan kecairan; mempelbagaikan pelaburan mengurangkan risiko.

tip.en: Convert % to a decimal and months to years before substituting.
tip.bm: Tukar % kepada perpuluhan dan bulan kepada tahun sebelum menggantikan nilai.

keyPoints.en: Credit cards give convenience but charge interest on unpaid balances, plus late-payment charges.
keyPoints.bm: Kad kredit memberi kemudahan tetapi mengenakan faedah atas baki tertunggak, serta caj lewat bayar.

keyPoints.en: Flat-rate loan: total repayment A = P + Prt; monthly instalment = A ÷ number of months.
keyPoints.bm: Pinjaman kadar sama rata: jumlah bayaran balik A = P + Prt; ansuran bulanan = A ÷ bilangan bulan.

keyPoints.en: Borrow only what you can repay; missed payments harm your credit record.
keyPoints.bm: Pinjam hanya apa yang mampu dibayar; bayaran tertunggak menjejaskan rekod kredit.
